description: This file contains utility functions for the GuzzleHttp library, including type description, header parsing, debugging, handler selection, user agent retrieval, CA bundle retrieval, header normalization, host proxy checking, and JSON encoding/decoding wrappers.

methods.name: describe_type
methods.description: Returns a string describing the type and class of the input variable.

methods.name: headers_from_lines
methods.description: Parses header lines into an associative array of headers.

methods.name: debug_resource
methods.description: Returns a debug stream resource based on the provided variable.

methods.name: choose_handler
methods.description: Creates and returns a default handler based on the environment.

methods.name: default_user_agent
methods.description: Retrieves the default User-Agent string for Guzzle.

methods.name: default_ca_bundle
methods.description: Returns the default CA certificate bundle path for the system.

methods.name: is_host_in_noproxy
methods.description: Checks if a host matches any no-proxy patterns.

methods.name: json_decode
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into PHP variable, throwing on error.

methods.name: json_encode
methods.description: Encodes PHP variable into JSON string, throwing on error.
